question: To what kind of previously accomplished recipient must this teaching be given only after a test lasting one year?
premises: The transmission is not open to all recipients without qualification.
A recipient who has previously accomplished the practice is a necessary condition for giving.
Only one who has been tested for a full year qualifies to receive it.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the one-year test is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has previously accomplished the practice and has been tested for one year.
